job.title: Fullstack Entwickler Angular (m/w/d) bei adesso – Siegen

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven record in agile teams, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, and techno-functional analysis translating business requirements into robust and scalable solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Fullstack Entwickler Angular (m/w/d) bei adesso – Siegen
cover_en.hook: I am excited about adesso’s reputation for delivering innovative digital solutions and its strong focus on SAP Commerce projects. With more than five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have the deep technical expertise and business-oriented mindset required for this role.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) features, covering product, catalog and pricing, using Java and Spring while adhering to platform best practices.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, customizing interceptors, populators and converters for complex data flows.

bullets.label: Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and resolved integration bottlenecks with SAP ERP and MDM systems across international teams.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Worked in Scrum teams, performed code reviews, supported production issues and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, leveraging Docker and Kubernetes for cloud-native releases.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to adesso’s projects.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Fullstack Entwickler Angular (m/w/d) bei adesso – Siegen
cover_de.hook: adesso steht für digitale Innovationen und setzt konsequent auf SAP-Commerce-Lösungen – ein Umfeld, in dem ich meine über fünfjährige Erfahrung bei Rockwell Automation und Shell optimal einbringen kann. Meine fundierten Kenntnisse in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) und meine Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen eng an den Geschäftsanforderungen auszurichten, passen exakt zu Ihrem Anforderungsprofil.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Entwickelte und implementierte umfassende SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) Funktionen für Produkt- und Katalogmanagement mit Java und Spring nach Best-Practice-Standards.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Erstellte und veröffentlichte OCC-REST-Web-Services sowie Headless-APIs für Storefronts und Drittanbieter und passte Interceptor, Populator und Converter für komplexe Datenflüsse an.

bullets.label: Integrationsarchitektur
bullets.text: Konzipierte und optimierte PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mit Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub und löste Integrationsengpässe zu SAP-ERP und MDM in internationalen Teams.

bullets.label: Agile Umsetzung
bullets.text: Arbeitete in Scrum-Teams, führte Code-Reviews durch, unterstützte den Produktivbetrieb und setzte CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2 mit Docker und Kubernetes um.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meine Beiträge für adesso zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: adesso is a leading German IT consultancy that combines deep SAP expertise with cutting-edge digital transformation projects. Its commitment to innovative, customer-centric solutions and its strong presence in the e-commerce domain align perfectly with my background in SAP Commerce Cloud and my passion for delivering value-driven, scalable platforms. Joining adesso would allow me to contribute to high-impact projects while growing within a forward-thinking, collaborative environment.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join adesso to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise in a forward-looking company that drives digital innovation and values collaborative, high-impact e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in the Fullstack Entwickler Angular role at adesso and would love to discuss how my Java, Spring and integration experience can add value to your team.
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Fullstack Entwickler Angular position at adesso. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java, Spring and API integration expertise, as well as proven agile delivery. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start after 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.
